audit_items.proof_trace: The BlobSchedule array in BeaconChainConfig is accessed and sorted without synchronization during concurrent block validation. Multiple goroutines can call MaxBlobsPerBlock() simultaneously (before forkchoice lock at receive_block.go:124), causing race conditions where slices.SortFunc modifies the shared array in-place, potentially reading stale or partially-sorted limits that could allow blocks exceeding the epoch-dependent max_blobs_per_block limit.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker submits multiple blocks with max+1 blob commitments simultaneously during epoch transition when BlobSchedule changes. Concurrent validations race: one reads old limit during sort, another completes validation with stale value. Block with excessive commitments passes validation due to TOCTOU race in unsorted BlobSchedule lookup, violating the epoch-dependent invariant.
